office_does: The county auditor runs Garfield County's elections, records documents, licenses vehicles and vessels, and keeps the county's accounts, payroll and budget.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor McKenzie Lueck, in office since 2020, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Garfield County Auditor since 2020 and an Executive Board member of the Washington State Association of County Auditors, running unopposed.
highlights: Auditor since 2020; elected unopposed in 2020 and 2022 [S1][S2][S3]
Third year on the Washington State Association of County Auditors Executive Board [S1]
Commits to 'fiscal transparency, secure elections, and accountable service' [S1]
